extraction.name: PASTIS: Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series Dataset
extraction.description: PASTIS is the first large-scale, open-access Satellite Image Time Series (SITS) dataset with both semantic and panoptic annotations for agricultural parcel segmentation. It consists of 2,433 sequences of multi-spectral images (10 channels) with panoptic annotations covering over 4000 km² across four regions of France. Each sequence contains between 38 and 61 observations taken between September 2018 and November 2019, with uneven temporal sampling due to cloud cover filtering. The dataset includes over 2 billion annotated pixels and 124,422 individualized parcels with unique instance labels and crop types.
extraction.license: Open-access dataset (no explicit license mentioned in paper)
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.publisher: LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN
extraction.citeAs: Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series with Convolutional Temporal Attention Networks, Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu, 2021
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite imagery collected from Sentinel-2 satellites with high revisit frequency. Data was automatically filtered by the satellite data provider THEIA to remove acquisitions with extensive cloud cover. The dataset spans four regions of France with diverse climates and crop distributions, covering almost 1% of the French Metropolitan territory. Annotations were derived from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS), with crop type accuracy verified via in situ control over 98% and relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Approximately 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover despite automatic filtering. The temporal sampling is irregular with a median of 5 days between acquisitions due to cloud cover and satellite orbit schedule.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite imagery with 10 spectral bands (after atmospheric correction and re-sampling at 10m resolution). Data was obtained from THEIA (Value-added data processed by CNES for the Theia data cluster using Copernicus data).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover by THEIA satellite data provider. No additional cloud detection or pre-processing was applied to the raw data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Atmospheric correction and re-sampling of Sentinel-2 data to 10m resolution. Sequences were organized into 2,433 square 128×128 patches. Parcels with more than 50% outside patch boundaries were annotated with void label. Background class represents non-agricultural land uses. Data was split into 5 folds with 1km buffer between images to avoid cross-fold contamination.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel was associated with a semantic label from an 18-class crop type nomenclature plus background. Each non-background pixel also received a unique instance label corresponding to its parcel index. Annotations were taken from the French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) with crop type accuracy verified via in situ control over 98%. Panoptic annotations include bounding boxes, pixel-precise masks, and crop types for 124,422 parcels.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) and manual annotation verification
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The dataset is highly unbalanced with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes. Cross-validation was performed with 5 folds chosen to have comparable class distributions and avoid cross-fold contamination.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 1 (each pixel has one semantic label and one instance label)
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: U-TAE (U-net with Temporal Attention Encoder) and PaPs (Parcels-as-Points) for panoptic segmentation, CenterMask network adapted for SITS, L-TAE (Lightweight Temporal Attention Encoder) for temporal encoding
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset and implementation are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/VSainteuf/pastis-benchmark and https://github.com/VSainteuf/utae-paps). The paper mentions that the dataset is open-access and encourages community contributions and usage.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables automated analysis of agricultural parcels which has major economic and environmental implications, including fair allocation of agricultural subsidies (50 billion euros per year in Europe and 22 billion in the US) and ensuring best crop rotation practices are respected. It supports applications like surveying urban development and deforestation monitoring.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common crop classes. The selection of patches favored those with rare crop types to decrease class imbalance. The dataset covers only 1% of French Metropolitan territory with four specific regions, potentially limiting geographic generalization.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset covers only four regions of France with specific climates and crop distributions. The temporal sampling is irregular due to cloud cover and satellite orbit schedule. Some parcels are fragmented or partially outside patch boundaries. The panoptic segmentation task is challenging due to ambiguous parcel borders and hard-to-classify parcel content. The dataset does not include temporal dynamics beyond the provided SITS.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, and Benchmarking for panoptic and semantic segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series (SITS). The dataset is designed for developing and evaluating models for agricultural parcel monitoring, crop type classification, and land cover mapping. Usage guidelines encourage cross-validation with the provided 5-fold scheme and emphasize the importance of temporal modeling for SITS analysis.
